noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

order.description: Specified element order. If unspecified, the natural ordering of the elements is used.

keys.description: For {@link MapType maps}, maintain the keys in sorted order.

title:
Annotation for {@link CollectionType collections} that controls the order maintained by the collection.

By default, {@link ArrayType arrays} preserve insertion order, but for performance {@link MapType maps} and
{@link SetType sets} do not guarantee any order. If desired, sorting can be specified by annotating the collection:
`@sorted set<string>`.

@see Ann.Indexed
name: Ann.Sorted
